comments.body: This is how all PhD students live, only math, engineering, computer science gets more really. It's ok for a few years and much higher than in other countries. It's a good degree and if you live with a roommate and cook for yourself you'll probably save around 500/month. I lived alone with this tier salary, no loan but I traveled a lot and at the end of PhD had about 10k in savings. Now that I have normal adult salary I don't know how i survived but I did :) caveat: I graduated 4 years ago.
comments.author: Haldenbach
